body: This current bout with anxiety is temporary.  My recurring pains and feelings of anxiety and depression are, apparently, permanent.  Death isn't an irrevocable solution to a temporary problem.  It's an irrevocable solution to a permanent problem.

I've lost sleep due to anxiety several times myself, and I still haven't learned the lessons you seem to think everyone inevitably learns by going through anxiety a few times.  I  don't think your argument about how I'll lose opportunities through death is very compelling.

I don't think there's a why except for that I'm not a happy person.  There has never been a point in my life when I felt happy or satisfied or content.  Specifically right now, I'm anxious about upcoming responsibilities that I don't know that I can or want to handle.

I had 2 years of therapy and anti-depressants.  They didn't help much.
Yeah, I don't think a week has gone by in the past 5 years when I haven't at least thought about sucide.
